title: Distributed ML Pipeline
summary: An MLOps system with continuous learning, drift detection, and model rollback for manufacturing quality prediction on the SECOM semiconductor dataset. It uses SDV's TVAESynthesizer to train a variational-autoencoder model on raw SECOM data and generate synthetic manufacturing records for the pipeline's data stream.
